── INES'S WEEK ──
Ines ran about 40 km a week before a stress reaction in the left shin and ten weeks off, and a physio has cleared Ines for walk-run three days a week, stopping if the shin aches. The goal is to run 30 minutes without walking by mid-October.
Recent weeks: none recorded.
This week: 5.1 km over 3 runs.
Body: "Shin quiet."
Feeling: "Nervous but happy to be back."

── THE DRAFT ──
Tells Ines: A clean, quiet first week back earns a small step up: same three run days, with each running interval growing from 1.5 min to 2…
The plan nudges one thing at a time, because that is how return weeks are supposed to feel almost boring. Your shin stayed at 0/10 across three sessions and was quiet the next morning, and your heart rate sat comfortably in zones 1 and 2.
Safety flag: Stop and call the physio if the shin aches

Mon: easy, walk-run, 20 min, 5 min walk to warm up, then 5 rounds of 2 min easy run and…
Tue: other, physio calf and hip routine, 20 – 30 min, unhurried and full range. Keeps…
Wed: easy, walk-run, 20 min, same shape as Monday, 5 rounds of 2 min run and 1 min walk…
Thu: rest. Full day off gives the shin a quiet window after two run days.
Fri: other, physio calf and hip routine, 20 – 30 min, same work as Tuesday. Second…
Sat: easy, walk-run, 22 min, 4 min walk to warm up, then 6 rounds of 2 min run and 1 min…
Sun: rest. Full recovery into next Monday.
